messages:
kevin_new: hey team, odd one — I was invited to a workspace and accepted the invite. UI shows me as a member, but the starter sample returns 403 with 'membership_pending' when I call generate.
jamal_sdk: can you paste the error body and whether you're using a user token or a service account key?
kevin_new: using the user API key from the account page, minimal repro below. it fails immediately on first request after accept.
```js
// quickstart.js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await c.generate({ model: 'gpt-open-1', prompt: 'hi' });
```
error body: {"code":"403","error":"membership_pending","detail":"membership not propagated to auth cache"}
rachel_support: thanks. we saw a propagation window where membership changes take a few seconds to replicate to auth caches — usually <30s but can spike. the SDK currently doesn't preflight auth so the first call can fail.
kevin_new: ah! i retried after ~20s and it worked. but surprised the quickstart doesn't mention this. wasted time troubleshooting my key.
jamal_sdk: we should do two things: 1) add a tiny preflight in the quickstart that calls GET /auth/whoami or GET /orgs/:id/memberships to confirm membership before hitting generate; 2) map the 'membership_pending' 403 to a typed error (OnboardingPropagationError) with a suggested retry/backoff and user-facing message.
ops: note — the auth cache TTL is 15s by default; under high write load we occasionally see 60s. ops will add metrics and a dashboard for replication lag.
ci-bot: created ticket DEVEX-1302 to add preflight + SDK mapping (jamal_sdk).
kevin_new: another note: i was using a browser-generated API key, then switched to a service-account key for CI and saw different behavior. maybe doc should clarify token types and propagation guarantees.
rachel_support: good call. adding a short paragraph in quickstart: "If you were just invited, wait up to 60s for permissions to propagate or run the preflight. Service account keys behave like project-level creds and may require workspace binding."
jamal_sdk: i'll open a tiny PR to catch membership_pending, print a clear instruction: "Membership update in progress — retry in a few seconds or run `GET /auth/whoami`. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding-propagation" and include the preflight.
kevin_new: perfect, that would have saved me a coffee. thanks! :coffee:
